newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes to rates.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes to rates.

text.p: A board meeting of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, ended on Thursday with no changes announced to interest rates.
The market had not expected the bank to make any changes.
The Riksbank's key interest rate, the repo rate, currently stands at 4.10 percent. It was last moved on December 17.
Its other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
